title: TITLE
methodology: This data was compiled from the official results (Form 16 of the electoral returns) gazetted as subsidiary legislation by the Election Commission of Malaysia. The gazetted results are available only in PDF format—the data shown here was scraped, standardised, and validated for publication on ElectionData.MY, as documented in [Thevananthan (2025)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-06502-7).

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date of polling day in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: election
fields.title: Election
fields.description: [String] Election identifier, GE-15 in this case

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [String] Name of state where the contest took place

fields.name: seat
fields.title: Constituency
fields.description: [String] Code (P.xxX) and name of the parliamentary seat

fields.name: voters_total
fields.title: Electorate Size
fields.description: [Integer] Total number of registered voters in the constituency

fields.name: ballots_issued
fields.title: Ballots Issued
fields.description: [Integer] Total number of ballots issued to voters

fields.name: ballots_not_returned
fields.title: Ballots Not Returned
fields.description: [Integer] Number of ballots issued but not returned (e.g. postal votes not received)

fields.name: votes_rejected
fields.title: Votes Rejected
fields.description: [Integer] Number of spoilt or rejected ballots

fields.name: majority
fields.title: Majority
fields.description: [Integer] Winning margin in votes (difference between 1st and 2nd place). 0 if uncontested

fields.name: n_candidates
fields.title: Number of Candidates
fields.description: [Integer] Number of candidates contesting the seat

fields.name: voter_turnout
fields.title: Voter Turnout (%)
fields.description: [Float] Ballots issued as a percentage of total registered voters. Null if uncontested

fields.name: majority_perc
fields.title: Majority (%)
fields.description: [Float] Winning majority as a percentage of valid votes. Null if uncontested

fields.name: votes_rejected_perc
fields.title: Rejected Votes (%)
fields.description: [Float] Rejected votes as a percentage of ballots issued. Null if uncontested

fields.name: ballots_not_returned_perc
fields.title: Ballots Not Returned (%)
fields.description: [Float] Unreturned ballots as a percentage of ballots issued. Null if uncontested

cite.instructions: Users wishing to reference this dataset in an academic context should cite Thevananthan (2025), which documents the construction of the dataset as well as the data itself.
cite.title: The Malaysian Election Corpus (MECo): Federal and State-Level Election Results from 1955 to 2025
cite.author: Thevananthan, Thevesh
